samplingSupport.source: Neighboring approved-image pixels of the same rig attachment family only; no new drawing.

boundaryRepair.removedFromRuntime: Exclusive-mask edge fragments are omitted from runtime surfaces; complete source pixels remain in original-layers/.

occlusionUnderlay.scope: Localized hidden coat fills merged into the front mesh; separate rear skirt, registered painted boot cavities, calf overlap and complete hidden shorts.

rig: Arm sleeves and hands consolidated into continuous shared weighted meshes. Skin-only thigh/shin chains with dual-quaternion volume corrective baked to standard Spine mesh deform keys. Full boots rigidly bound to a single foot bone, independently counter-rotated. Leg IK baked to FK; planted cuff targets on ground.

jumpMouthRepair.scale: Constant original smile proportions; no independent joy-driven scaling.
jumpMouthRepair.movement: Head-bound, with at most 0.65 source pixels of local lift tied to actual airborne height.

articulation.hem: Each hem grab shares exactly the hand grip vertex position; wrist counter-rotation preserves cloth orientation.
articulation.face: Two eyes, brows, nose, mouth and cheeks on separate bones; closed-eye and soft-smile attachments plus stunned, shocked, grin and determined expression attachments.
articulation.hair: Head-following hair with restrained inertial lag: crown at most 2.1 degrees, side locks at most 1.155 degrees, vertical offset at most 0.8 source pixels; one damped landing rebound.
articulation.boots: Opaque painted interior cavities, rigid complete boot shells, registered calf overlap, antialiased joint masks.
articulation.volleyball: Parabolic bounce, continuous spin and short contact squash; lower ellipse edge meets the painted crown at source pixel (462,14).
articulation.groundedLegs: Solve leg targets after the loop envelope; new clips sampled at 120 Hz, original V4 clips at unchanged 60 Hz.

generationMode: Built-in ImageGen; prompt-set.json records the executed local fill/expression prompts.

headOcclusionRepair.scalp: Single ImageGen head plate registered by ear landmarks; continuous clean ears/jaw shared by face and scalp, without overlapping old cut contours.
headOcclusionRepair.rearHair: Complete independently painted rear hairstyle with shaded layered locks and naturally outlined nape tufts. Shares front-hair topology and base weights, excluding the front-only fringe pivot; lies behind neck/face/hood.
headOcclusionRepair.frontHair: Retain only the main front-hair contour and antialias fringe; remove detached rear locks and stray cut pixels.

leftNapeRedraw.scope: Only the exposed lower-left rear curtain; broad flowing tapered locks replace repeated dangling needles. Original crown/right and concealed inner nape preserved.

fringeMotion.pivot: hair_fringe is a child of the restrained crown, rooted at source (490,250).
fringeMotion.scope: Front fringe only, additional rotation up to 2.1 degrees blended toward the tips with broad weight transitions. Crown, rear, outer-left and side motion remain unchanged.
fringeMotion.artwork: Original painted front hair, UVs and topology preserved; no new image patches.

leftOutlineOwnership.source: Existing painted front-hair and registered head alpha mattes
leftOutlineOwnership.scope: Only the redundant outer-left rear tip at source x=201..222, y=500..540 and its antialias fringe; fade ends at x=240 and y=560. Lower nape remains untouched.

front.scope: Median alpha trim at collar and hem, constrained to the approved outer silhouette; no new painted pixels.

rear.scope: Median alpha trim at collar and hem, constrained to the approved outer silhouette; no new painted pixels.

garmentEdges.pants: Remove navy ownership remnants and obsolete cutout ink from front-side cloth; pants retain their dedicated complete painted attachment.

rearPainting.registration: Resize 1950x796 to the existing 650x265 rear attachment at source (260,970); constrain to the approved outside silhouette.
rearPainting.scope: Complete continuous yellow rear fabric, no shorts cutouts or duplicate front-hem interior ink. The former opaque outside extrusion is removed.

garmentEdges.frontSide: Reuse registered completed rear-cloth RGB in the existing front side flaps below their front matte; preserve original outer ink, alpha, rig and hand contact.
garmentEdges.collar: Rejoin the existing complete painted hood rim at source x=700..855, y=570..665; omit orange nape fragments and the old circular protrusion above the hood.

leftHairRepair.pivot: Dedicated hair_outer_L keeps the outer locks coherent, with bounded 0.5 degree recoil; all hair timelines damped to follow the head.
leftHairRepair.weights: Outer-left locks keep 92% hair support on one pivot; correction fades between source x=335..410 and y=430..530.
leftHairRepair.paint: Original approved front hair RGB and complete painted rear hair retained; no new painted patches.

dragInteraction.behaviour: Painted-pixel hit testing, pointer capture, grab-point anchoring, bounded inertial sway, release fall aligned with landing-to-idle transition; cancel/focus loss release safely.

clawMachine.style: Rounded cream enamel, orange joint caps, friendly smiling hub and soft orange contact pads.
clawMachine.grip: Baked two-link IK follows the painted raincoat shoulder points; metal pieces stay rigid.
clawMachine.depth: Linkages and third finger behind the head; rubber tips in front of the coat, behind the face; short piston and hub above the head.
clawMachine.release: claw_release runs on track 1 immediately on release, independent of the landing clip on track 0; the rig stays at the release height and retracts while the character falls.
clawMachine.visibility: Hidden during idle and all ten existing actions.

limitations: 共十三条角色动作/表情动画，另加 claw_release 机械抓夹释放辅助动画；预览已接入鼠标交互，尚未制作转身或正式 Windows 桌宠应用。
使用 Spine 4.2 官方运行时验证；尚未在 Spine 编辑器中执行导入。本项目是 JSON/atlas/PNG，不含原生 .spine 文件。

animations.label: 待机呼吸
animations.description: 呼吸、眨眼、笑口切换，眉毛和鼻子轻动，发梢轻摇。

animations.label: 抓衣角蹦跳
animations.description: 屈膝蓄力，抓着衣角上提；腾空笑眯眼，发梢回弹。

animations.label: 开心连跳
animations.description: 抓住衣角连续蹦跳，双膝收起，头发随起落摆动。

animations.label: 头顶颠球
animations.description: 抬头认真盯球，屈膝顶起排球，蓝黄排球连续落下再弹起。

animations.label: 左右摇摆
animations.description: 脚下站稳，轻轻歪头摇摆，衣角、袖子和发梢一起跟随。

animations.label: 得意小跳
animations.description: 咧嘴露齿笑，抓着衣角轻快小跳两下。

animations.label: 白眼呆住
animations.description: 白圈圈眼、歪嘴和一小滴口水，呆呆晃一下。

animations.label: 惊讶大叫
animations.description: 瞪圆眼睛、挑起眉毛，张大嘴巴惊呼。

animations.label: 咧嘴笑
animations.description: 笑眯眼和露齿笑，配合轻轻点头和发梢回弹。

animations.label: 认真脸
animations.description: 皱起小眉毛，抿嘴盯着上方，发梢轻轻晃动。

animations.label: 抓夹提起
animations.description: 短机械臂伸下，三爪合拢雨衣肩部，身体随后被提起。

animations.label: 抓夹悬空晃晃
animations.description: 抓夹托着雨衣两侧，双腿交替轻晃，手臂、衣角与发梢跟随。

animations.label: 张爪放下
animations.description: 抓爪张开、机械臂收回，角色伸腿落地、屈膝缓冲，再恢复待机。

volleyballSizing.contact: Ellipse lower edge remains on the moving painted crown; radius included in each translation key.
